A Light Weed/Alcohol Crossover
I took 3 Gabitril around 1 or 2am and started to feel it's effects at around 4:30am. My vision sort of skips around, and I don't feel like I'm totally aware of myself. When I walk my steps are heavy and my sense of balance is off. It feels like if I took a tiny hit of marijuana and a couple sips of alcohol. Personally I like it.
It makes me kind of tired, and quite hot.
